question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **EXIGUOUS**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Scanty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Exiguous"** means something that is very small in size or quantity, or insufficient. (अत्यल्प)
 
 
• **Example:** The company’s exiguous profits barely covered their operating expenses.
 
 

 
• **"Scanty"** refers to something that is insufficient or meager in amount or size. (अल्प)
 
 
• **Example:** The scanty rainfall this year has led to drought conditions in the region.
